amaras-story.title: Amara tells a story
amaras-story.summary: Amara tells Emma a folktale about a boy and a lion.
lines: Well then. Once upon a time, there was a boy.
Then he went into the forest to look for firewood.
He saw a very big lion!
No. He sat down and sang a song.
The lion listened, rested and went away.
In the end, the boy went home with the firewood. My story ends there.
